finding: Offline qualification of Package 171-R3 completed: addresses Independent Review HND-F1602-R2-REVIEW-197845D6 by enforcing post-relaxation KKT stationarity on actual damage d_{k+1}, strict physical gating of checkpoint serialization (requiring zero healing violations and force/energy drift <= 2%), coupled-field consistency verification between mechanical and phase subiterations, and recasting spectral radius claims into testable experimental predictions under falsifiable hypothesis omega_d = 0.5.

idealized_scalar_model.characterization: Theoretical 1D scalar model proxy; not an experimentally measured coupled Jacobian eigenvalue.

coupled_spectrum_perspective.statement: In the authentic multi-DOF coupled system, strain-damage interactions involve multiple modes. If dominant oscillatory modes have Re(lambda) in [-1, 0), omega_d = 0.5 contracts these modes (mu in [0, 0.5)). The full-system spectral radius and iteration trajectory are empirical outcomes to be determined by solver execution, not pre-declared constants.

numerical_hypothesis.hypothesis_falsification_condition: If outer iteration reaches 100 without satisfying strict coupled convergence and physical acceptance criteria.

defect_1_post_relaxation_kkt.mechanism: driver_package171_r3_c6_coupled_pdas.py explicitly computes kkt_post = solver.kkt(relaxed_damage) after convex blending; kkt_post residuals govern convergence and telemetry.

defect_2_gated_checkpoint.mechanism: Physical acceptance requires healing_violations_count == 0, thermo_consistent == True, monotonicity_consistent == True, force_discrepancy <= 2%, energy_discrepancy <= 2%, and kkt_final passed. Any failure blocks converged_checkpoint_01.json serialization.

defect_3_coupled_field_consistency.mechanism: Upon convergence, a final mechanical subproblem is solved with relaxed_damage to obtain mutually consistent displacement, reaction force, and energies before physical gating.

defect_4_claim_discipline.mechanism: All unmeasured claims of measured lambda = -1, deadbeat convergence, and rho <= 0.875 have been removed and replaced with testable hypothesis framing.
